rationale: Obadiah's oracle 'about Edom' (1:1) names Esau and the people Genesis 36 traces to him: 'how Esau will be pillaged' (1:6), 'the wise men of Edom' and 'the mountains of Esau' (1:8), 'your mighty men, O Teman' (1:9), and the charge, 'Because of the violence against your brother Jacob' (1:10). Teman is the first-named son of Eliphaz at Genesis 36:11 and a chief at 36:15. Genesis 36:8 gives the identification Obadiah assumes, 'Esau (that is, Edom)'. Ramban, on Genesis 36:31, quotes Obadiah 1:9 to show that 'the land of the Temanites' belonged to Edom. Graded explicit_reference because Obadiah names Esau, Edom, Teman and the brother relation. Graded strong, not explicit, following conn-gen25-twins-malachi1: Obadiah names the persons and the people but does not quote or retell Genesis 36. Whether Teman in Obadiah means the clan, a district or a town is not settled by either text, and the row does not depend on it.
